text:
Sam (sales): Quick for SummitCare POC kickoff tomorrow. They need: peering vs PrivateLink recommendation, how to whitelist one egress IP, minimal firewall ports, whether SNI/original client IP survive, and a one-line for procurement about logs/keys.

Nora (netops): Short answer: peering preserves client source IP at the network layer. PrivateLink places connector ENIs in the customer's VPC so network-level source will be ENI IPs (not original).

Diego (eng): For HTTP(S) we can emit X-Original-Client-IP or a signed header: X-Redwood-Sig: " + "<base64(hmac)|ip|ts|reqid>" + " that they can verify. For raw TLS streams the only way to see true client IP is peering or an in-VPC proxy that terminates/re-injects metadata.

Nora (netops): Minimal firewall rules to paste:
- Outbound TCP 443 to Redwood control plane CIDR (we'll provide exact CIDRs during handshake).
- If PrivateLink: allow inbound TCP 443 from connector ENI CIDRs (provided at setup).
- If peering: allow TCP 443 across peering and update route tables.

Sam (sales): Can they get a single static egress IP to whitelist?

Nora (netops): Yes. Pattern: NAT connector egress through a NAT Gateway/Transit with an Elastic IP in their account. That gives a single egress IP they control. We don't supply an IP inside their VPC.

Priya (security): SNI: visible in ClientHello unless ESNI is used or a TLS proxy rewrites it. If their IDS does TLS interception they must preserve/re-add signed headers. One-liners for procurement: "Logs: request metadata and operational logs are retained per customer-configured retention in the Private deploy control plane; payload content is not stored unless explicitly enabled. Keys: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported."

Diego (eng): Perf note for the POC: if they expect sustained >500Mbps or many parallel streams recommend peering + TGW + dedicated connector subnet to avoid MTU fragmentation and ENI bandwidth limits. For burst SLA propose Dedicated capacity commit.

ticket-bot: Handshake ticket: https://redwood.internal/handshakes/SC-7782  - netops to upload ENI CIDRs and sample SG by EOD.

Sam (sales): Perfect. I'll send this to SummitCare and ask them to pick peering vs PrivateLink on the call. If netops can attach the CIDRs and SG snippet to the ticket by EOD, I'll lock the kickoff. :thumbsup:
